newsitem.title: USA: Brite Voice Systems in software agreement.
newsitem.headline: Brite Voice Systems in software agreement.

text.p: Brite Voice Systems Inc said Friday it signed a technology partnership with Amteva Technologies Inc, a computer telephony software company.
Brite Voice provides voice processing systems and services and telecommunications management to companies, financial institutions, newspapers and telecom carriers.

Brite Voice said it will work closely with Amteva to develop applications in conjunction with a separate software partnership involving Amteva, Dialogic Corp and AT&T Corp. Brite Voice will also launch a new product program that will feature multi-application, multi-network and multimedia capabilities.
Brite Voice ultimately plans to offer applications for a broad range of customer-selected computer platforms.
Its stock closed up one Friday at 15-3/8.
